description: 春日市 指定緊急避難場所一覧(福岡都市圏共通フォーマット) [evacuation shelters and public facilities] is a dataset listed in BODIK Open Data Catalogue Service (data.bodik.jp), Japanese local governments, an open data portal, published or maintained by 春日市. 春日市が指定している避難所・避難場所の一覧データです。 自分の地区以外の避難所にも避難は可能です。 最寄りの避難所をチェックしましょう。 ▼避難所・避難場所の分類 •一時避難場所：自宅の近くにある公園や学校のグラウンドです。 •広域避難場所：大火災の発生など、一時避難場所からさらに避難する場所です。 •一時避難所：各地区公民館。 自宅で生... Coverage: 春日市. The portal files it under the publisher 春日市. Its tags are 位置情報, 災害, 避難所, 防災. It offers 4 resource(s) in csv, pdf. The portal shows 2025-06-16 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. Suitability for infrastructure simulation has not been checked. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-bodik-portal.
